mechanism: Naproxen may reduce atovaquone absorption through GI irritation and decreased gastric pH, potentially compromising atovaquone efficacy in treating Pneumocystis jirovecii pneumonia or toxoplasmosis.
action: Monitor atovaquone serum concentrations if concurrent use is necessary; separate administration times and ensure adequate food intake with atovaquone; consider alternative NSAID or analgesic if possible.
